generate_lead.meaning: Inquiry accepted by Resend; delivery and qualification remain separate.

book_call.meaning: A fresh Cal.com booking reported as accepted with no payment pending.

newsletter_submit.meaning: Signup request submitted to Buttondown; opt-in is not yet confirmed.

newsletter_signup.meaning: Legacy name for a signup request, not a confirmed subscriber.

booking_requested.meaning: Booking awaiting organizer confirmation or payment.

try_extension.meaning: An interactive SQL example was opened.

try_query_run.meaning: A SQL statement was run; this can be an unedited example.

tutorial_catalog_page.meaning: A tutorial catalog page was selected.

tutorial_catalog_explore.meaning: The tutorial catalog was opened from its introduction.

tutorial_read_progress.meaning: A tutorial reading milestone was observed; not proof of completion.

tutorial_download.meaning: A tutorial resource download was requested.

tutorial_challenge_hint.meaning: A tutorial challenge hint was opened.

tutorial_challenge_solution.meaning: A tutorial challenge solution was opened.

tutorial_challenge_attempt.meaning: A tutorial challenge answer was checked.

tutorial_challenge_complete.meaning: A tutorial challenge passed; it may have used the supplied solution.

bluesky_discussion_click.meaning: An article discussion link was clicked.

booking_start.meaning: An event type was selected in the scheduler.

booking_external_click.meaning: The direct scheduler fallback was opened.

enquiry_accepted.meaning: Diagnostic companion to generate_lead; never count both as leads.

try_extension_failed.meaning: An interactive SQL example failed to load.

booking_result_unknown.meaning: A booking callback lacked enough information to count a confirmed booking.
